description: Exact quote from the contract's own math: the amount out, price, fees per hop and price impact. Give amount (what is sold) or buy_amount (what should come out; the quote finds the input). Pass account to check its balances, trustlines and whether the trade would push it over the Event Horizon.

account.description: Optional: the account that would trade.

amount.description: Amount of sell to trade, e.g. "100".

buy.description: HITZ, XLM, USDC (any case), or a token contract address (C…).

buy_amount.description: Instead of amount: how much of buy to receive.

sell.description: HITZ, XLM, USDC (any case), or a token contract address (C…).

name: quote
title: Quote a trade
